clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Sprite Jumpsprocket works among gnomish and dwarven artisans. Like many gnomes who sought refuge after Gnomeregan fell, she pursues engineering alongside fellow tinkers.

Sprite Jumpsprocket works as an apprentice engineer in Stormwind's Dwarven District, where gnomes and dwarves forge metal and design intricate devices side by side. She has made her place in the kingdom's capital, where apprentice tinkers hone their craft under experienced masters. Their inventive minds help maintain the Alliance's everyday mechanisms and marvels.

After Gnomeregan fell, displaced gnomes spread across Alliance lands, bringing their skill in tinkering, chemistry, and mechanics. In Stormwind, they found a welcoming sanctuary in the Dwarven District, with its blast furnaces and workbenches. Sprite Jumpsprocket reflects their resolve to master engineering despite the hardships her kin have faced.
